title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I recently attended a wedding at at the end a few brothers were called to the stage to take photographs. Some people were using their mobiles to take photos, some people digital cameras and their was a video camera too. A brother advised us that we should avoid posing for these photos but he did not give a reason as he was not 100% sure on the ruling. A few other brothers said they will only be saving these on their mobiles and not publishing them in anyway and some simply said there is nothing wrong and that the ruling was for something in the past about idol worshiping and that they will not be using to idol worship. Can you please advise on the correct ruling on this issue and please send me some hadith and Quran aayaats which help to convince everyone either way. May ALLAH reward you all for your efforts and may ALLAH make the academy a source of knowledge for all. please rememeber me in your duas. 4146 views Q. I'v passed BTECH(COMPUTERS) in 2008 but not able to get a job until 2011. 4128 views Q. میں نے 2013 میں اتر پردیش کرکٹ ایسوسی ایشن کانپور سے کرکٹ امپائرنگ کاامتحان پاس کیا ہے۔ اور اب میں ہندوستان میں یوپی ، دہلی اور دوسرے صوبوں کے کلب کے ذریعہ منعقدہ میچوں میں امپائر نگ کررہاہوں۔ فی الحال میری کمائی کا یہی ایک ذریعہ/پیشہ ہے؟کیا اس کی اجازت ہے یا نہیں؟ 1512 views Q. eating of non halal meat unknowingly 3529 views Q. Allah has made me a software engineer by profession.Currently working in a reputed software company in India. I want to leave this company and start my own work as I do not feel my Iman each time so strong that I may be able to violate the cultures of the company which are not according to sharia like wearing pent shirt, Answering greetings of Na Maharam.Also things like the mendatory insurance component in the salary which I do not want to subscribe for, still deducted from my salary. In short these and some other things inspire me to start my own job.My parents have taken loan from bank.The loan includes interest terms also..Allah helps them to repay the loan via me.(However I am not the only source but Allah has made me as a major contributor towards repayment of the loan). Is this okay If I ask My parents to give me few months (2-3) to collect money by the salary instead of giving them and made investment in new work? However I have talked already to my parents about it that this new work may require some investment of a good portion of 2-3 months salary and they have given there consent. So the first question is what is better?Should I continue to work in the company and made small investments towards the own work (Which I feel a long process). Or go with the instant investment by putting the portion of salary towards new job which Allah gives currently to my parents via me.Ofcaurse success will be there only if Allah wills. My second question is regarding the new work I wants to start. InshaAllah it will be website based work initially. The plan is to provide a internet based facility to people where people can learn by there and other people's learnings. Learning means any learning what people may put on the website.Hence this learning can be according to sharia and opposite to sharia also. Like one people my place his/her learning as "Speak truth even in tough situation" and another one may place his learning as "Alcohol is good for health".So people may read both wrong and right learnings also.In addition the learnings can be of any other type also like business learning etc. Its like an opinion of someone by his/her experience. So the second question is such service/website allowed. The third question is about charging the people who use this service. Someone may be allowed to pay amount(as a fees of using this website) if He/She feels that he/she has benefitted via this website. So its upto that "Somebody" whether he wants to pay for the use website or not. Is such earning halal,(Please let me know even if its halal but undesirable)? Also should I set a maximum amount which a person can pay if he/she wills to pay? Please consider the use of this website for business organizations also where it becomes obligatory chargable. 3091 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 27769 Country: United States of America Title: I am a Muslim working in a gas station in Calif. USA. My manager and the owner are good Muslims. Both helped me a lot when I first came to this country a year ago. We don?t sell any liqueur or lottery. The mother company keeps pushing the owner to sell liqueur or he would loose the store. Today; the manager bought a few beer boxes and put them on the shelf at more expensive price than the liqueur store next door so nobody would buy them. He told me we have to do it till we pass the inspection by the mother company. I?m afraid if I ask them to leave they would get upset. They would think that I?m showing off that I?m more religious than them because they already told me we won?t sell them. Also; it?s not easy to find a job nowadays especially with good people like them. What should I do? Please answer me as soon as possible. Question: I?m a Muslim working in a gas station in Calif. USA. My manager and the owner are good Muslims. Both helped me a lot when I first came to this country a year ago. We don?t sell any liqueur or lottery. The mother company keeps pushing the owner to sell liqueur or he would loose the store. He told me we have to do it till we pass the inspection by the mother company. I?m afraid if I ask them to leave they would get upset. They would think that I?m showing off that I?m more religious than them because they already told me we won?t sell them. Also; it?s not easy to find a job nowadays especially with good people like them. What should I do? Please answer me as soon as possible. Answer ID: 27769 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2022/D=429/k=1431) As it is haram to brew wine and give someone to drink in the same way, selling wine is haram as well. The holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم) has cursed all these people. Hence, if your manager has firm intention not to sell it, then you can work with him and there is no need to leave the job. And if you fear that his intention might change, then you should intend to leave the job and should not think what he will think about you. It is must for you to save your iman. Also when the inspection is done the manager should damage it because it is not lawful to take its price. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
